product.title: Sail & Splash Excursion in Ft. Lauderdale

description.text: Hop aboard a catamaran for a sailing excursion in Fort Lauderdale available in English and Spanish. Sit back and relax while you tour the waterways of the city known as the “Venice of America.” Next, head out to the Atlantic Ocean and enjoy the rhythm of calypso music and breaking waves. Equipment, safety briefings, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Fort Lauderdale's waterways and coastal wildlife. Ideal for groups on Fort Lauderdale's Intracoastal Waterway who want a private captain without handling marina logistics.
